about.description: Meet CA Agency, a full-service influencer marketing agency in Dubai with global reach and K-beauty specialism, behind 3,000+ creator campaigns.
about.heading: About CA Agency
about.intro: We build creator careers and the campaigns that come with them. For over 7 years we have helped creators grow with intent and connected brands with the audiences that genuinely trust them. Real relationships, real reach, real results.
about.whoWeAreP1: We're a close-knit team of talent managers, partnership leads, and creative minds, led by our founders and driven by a genuine love for what creators do. We've spent years in the creator world, and we know it takes more than a follower count to make a partnership work. It takes trust, the right fit, and someone who genuinely has the creator's back. It also takes real community, an audience that listens because it was built with care, not chased.
about.storyText: Established in 2019, we're an agency built on genuine partnerships and a real understanding of the creators we represent. What started as a focused team has grown into a trusted partner for creators and brands alike, working across beauty, lifestyle, and tech. We're here to help creators grow, protect what makes them unique, and build relationships that last, not just close deals. Behind every creator is an engaged community, and it's those communities, built on trust and authenticity, that sit at the heart of everything we do. We take care of the details so creators can focus on their craft, and brands connect with audiences in a way that feels real.

whatDoesCaAgencyDo.question: What does CA Agency do?
whatDoesCaAgencyDo.answer: CA Agency is a full-service influencer marketing agency for beauty and skincare brands. We plan and run creator campaigns on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, manage a roster of creators, produce branded content in-house, amplify it with paid social, and advise brands on positioning and market entry. Founded in 2019 and headquartered in Dubai, we have delivered 3,000+ creator campaigns.

whoDoYouWorkWith.question: Which brands and industries do you work with?
whoDoYouWorkWith.answer: We specialise in beauty: skincare, K-beauty, color cosmetics, haircare, and beauty retail, alongside lifestyle and consumer tech. Brands we have created campaigns for include YSL Beauty, Fenty Beauty, NARS, Sephora, Kylie Cosmetics, ELEMIS, Anua, Samsung, HONOR.

whereDoYouOperate.question: Where does CA Agency run campaigns?
whereDoYouOperate.answer: We run campaigns for brands in the USA and internationally, including the UK, Canada, Australia, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, the wider GCC, South Korea, and Asia. Our team is based in Dubai and works in English, Arabic, Korean, French, Spanish, and German.

whatIsKBeauty.question: What is K-beauty influencer marketing?
whatIsKBeauty.answer: K-beauty influencer marketing uses creators to introduce Korean skincare through routines, textures, and ingredient education rather than traditional ads. We help Korean brands such as Anua, Mixsoon, Purito, Haruharu Wonder reach Western audiences, and help international brands adopt the routine-led content style K-beauty made popular.

howDoYouSelect.question: How do you choose the right creators?
howDoYouSelect.answer: We start with audience fit: who follows the creator, where they live, and whether that community overlaps with your customer. We then check engagement quality, content style, brand safety, and signs of fake followers before shortlisting. Creators are briefed to keep their own voice, and sponsored content is disclosed in line with platform and advertising rules.

whatPlatforms.question: Which platforms do you work on?
whatPlatforms.answer: Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. TikTok drives discovery and trends, Instagram Reels carry polished routines and product moments, and YouTube suits in-depth reviews and tutorials. We recommend the mix based on your audience and goals.

howMeasureSuccess.question: How do you measure campaign results?
howMeasureSuccess.answer: We track delivery, reach, engagement, traffic, conversions, and sentiment, and report in plain language with learnings for the next campaign. When creator content is amplified through paid social, we add creative testing and conversion tracking so you can see the return on spend.

howMuchCost.question: How much does an influencer campaign cost?
howMuchCost.answer: It depends on the number of creators, their audience size, the platforms and deliverables, and how long you want to use the content. After a short discovery call we send a tailored proposal with a clear cost breakdown.

howGetStarted.question: How do I get started with CA Agency?
howGetStarted.answer: Send us a message through the contact form or email info@caagency.com. We'll book a discovery call to understand your goals, then send a tailored campaign proposal.
